title: Mall World Military Areas
content: I was wondering if any of y'all have more world dreams within the military sections of mall world. I've had dreams in the malls and dreams in the medical areas (terrifying), but the ones that really get me are in these giant military areas. Just like the bathrooms, they're much too large. The facilities are gigantic. Some of them house giant mecha and things. There are always tons of copies. Like an aircraft hanger with hundreds of aircraft. Last night I was talking with an employee there and they were telling me about *alien brains* they have, and how they keep them unconscious by sedation. It's always crazy stuff like that, but it feels... more genuine than the rest of mall world. When I wake up after walking around a *one thousand seat bathroom*, it's pretty easy to dismiss. Creepy military areas with really freaky tech? Less easy to dismiss.
